# customer0

> Index of customer0 spikes. Each spike has its own site, source, llms.txt and eval verdict.

## Spikes

- [tether](https://tether.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Check what an agent says it did against the output it did it with. Verdict: disproven.
- [port](https://port.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Install agent infra on your own Cloudflare account. Preview it, keep it, or tear it down. Verdict: building.
- [marionette](https://marionette.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Hard ideas you can poke: autoscaling, PID, interlocks, sync. Each page is a tiny neural network wired by hand, with no ifs. Verdict: building.
- [amber](https://amber.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Pause code your agent wrote. A script stops at tool() until a human answers, then resumes mid-loop with no replay. Verdict: building.
- [accrete](https://accrete.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Build each npm CLI your agent calls once in a container, check it against the real tool, then run the saved copy in an isolate with no container boot. Verdict: building.
- [hand](https://hand.coey.dev/llms.txt): Computer use without pixel guessing. The device lists what can be clicked, Clef picks one with a probability, a writer is called only for new text. Verdict: building.
- [teeth](https://teeth.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Plants small bugs in changed TypeScript files, runs the real tests against each, and reports the share the tests catch. Verdict: disproven.
- [ghost](https://ghost.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Before an agent clicks, will the click land? A model that writes the rule beats a model that looks at the page. Verdict: disproven.
- [my-ax](https://my-ax.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Your own agent: chats, saved tools, jobs, and your own computers that it can use after you approve them. Verdict: building.
- [radar](https://radar.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Reads new arXiv papers each day, scores them for agent work, and hands the best to my-ax as tools. Verdict: building.
- [mcp-trust](https://trust.customer0.dev/llms.txt): An MCP gateway that lets an agent write only to the places you named in your own prompt, and call only the provider you named. Verdict: proven.
- [trees](https://trees.customer0.dev/llms.txt): One Intent UI document, six UI trees. A small IAP host built from the spec renders it through HTML and terminal bindings; build a view once from an intent, then every tree reuses it. Verdict: building.
- [rail](https://rail.customer0.dev/llms.txt): Minimal trunk-based CI/CD entirely on Cloudflare primitives. Push to an Artifacts repo; one Workflow runs R2 lockfile cache, 4 parallel Sandbox checks, a network-isolated Worker Loader preview gate, atomic DO promotion, and emits human + JSON receipts. Verdict: proven.
